title: DisInforMeter Demonstrator (DE-CONSPIRATOR Deliverable D5.2)
description:
An interactive, public demonstrator of the DisInforMeter Toolkit: a validated population indicator for receptivity to, and detection of, Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI), developed across five studies and more than 10,000 respondents.

Visitors can run the complete guided experience (19-item receptivity questionnaire, personalised educational feedback, behavioural headline-choice task) or inspect the toolkit as a reference resource: three instrument versions, a 151-item bank, a 27-item short module in 19 languages, the feedback logic, the choice task, the five-study evidence chain, and downloadable survey, scoring, translation and implementation files.

Responses are processed only in the visitor's browser and are never transmitted or stored. Receptivity and detection are separate readouts and are never combined into a single susceptibility score.

Published at https://disinformeter.deconspirator.eu
notes: Deliverable D5.2 of the DE-CONSPIRATOR project (Detecting and Countering Information Suppression from A Transnational Perspective), funded by the European Union under Horizon Europe Grant Agreement No. 101132671, topic HORIZON-CL2-2023-DEMOCRACY-01-02.
